name: ApexVibe Music Bot
description: Lightweight Telegram voice-chat music bot with fast YouTube playback

STRING_SESSION.description: Assistant Pyrogram string session; required for voice-chat streaming

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Private Telegram log group or channel ID

OWNER_USERNAME.description: Owner username used in informational messages, without @

UPDATE_CHANNEL.description: Update channel username or invite link

SUPPORT_GROUP.description: Support group username or invite link

SUPPORT_CHANNEL.description: Support channel username or invite link

AUTOPLAY.description: Automatically select one related song when the queue is empty

YT_COOKIES.description: Optional Netscape cookies.txt contents or base64 value for YouTube reliability

COOKIE_URL.description: Optional private raw cookies.txt URL; use YT_COOKIES instead when possible

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: Optional YouTube Data API v3 key for faster song search
